title: CNC Machinist
description:
On-Board PMO is hiring a CNC Machinist in Valley View, OH!

About Us:
On-Board PMO, Incorporated is an on-site contract service provider for a local manufacturing entity providing full time positions to our employees. We offer benefits, paid time off, paid holidays and 401k after a probationary time.

Type: Full Time Permanent
Title: CNC Machinist
Compensation: $21.50 - 23.50 per hour
Benefits: Eligible for complete benefits package after 60 days
Schedule: 2nd and 3rd shift

For a limited time, we are offering a $1,000 Sign-On Bonus!!
($250 after 1 month of employment, $250 after 3 months of employment, and  $500 after 6 months of employment)

This position will be responsible for, but not limited to:

Basic Function :
Produce quality product in a safe manner to meet the company and customer needs. Draws upon training and production experiences with the equipment and the process to make quality aerospace components. Applicant should possess training and experience in machining Bridgeport Mills/CNC Lathes or CNC Mills. At a minimum, gaging skills should include micrometers, depth micrometers, calipers, and dial indicators (optical comparator is a plus). Must be able to read and interpret blueprints and understand Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T). Where manual material handling is performed, the contractor shall enforce a fifty-pound maximum manual lift limit. Safety shall be the first consideration when performing work at or on behalf of Client. All personnel entering the job site must attend a site safety orientation. The orientation is a summary of applicable OSHA requirements, site specific material and Client policy and procedures.

Responsibilities:
Includes the following & other duties as assigned. Assess the quality, robustness, and capability of the process and making decisions, with others, to halt or modify production as needed if the process does not meet quality and/or safety standard.

Organization Relationships:
Works regularly with shift production employees as well as Leadership throughout the Client and Contractor Groups.


Production Cell Activities:
  • General Weigh/Sort of material
  • Tool Prep
  • DPS/TRACC: Principles of 5S
  • Foreign Object Damage/Debris
  • Tumbling
  • Sandblasting
  • Oven Operations
  • General Hand Client -Up
  • Manual Press Operations
  • Semi-Automatic Press Operation
  • Clicker Press Operation
  • Manual Cloth Impregnation
  • Etching
  • Poly L assembly
  • Hand deburring
  • Milling and Drilling
  • Turning and Boring
  • Other machining processes
  • Sump Sucker/Coolant Change
  • Part Marking
Physical Demands:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to talk or hear. The employee is required to stand (for extended periods of time), walk, and sit. In addition, the employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to twenty-five pounds/55 max.

Employee Education/Training:
Employees must attend all required classroom training classes and on-line learning thru the I Learn system. All training requires employees to take required tests and receive a passing score. Most training requires 8O % or better to maintain employment.

Qualifications:
Candidate must have a CNC Certification or 3 years’ experience operating a CNC Lathes/Mills. Must be able to read Blueprints and have experience with GD&T, (Geometric, Dimension and Tolerance. Shop math skills to the tenth, hundredth, and thousandth

Additional Site Information:
  • Clean and climate-controlled environment (72F all year long)
  • 8 hour shift – 2 x 15 min breaks and 1 x 30 minute lunch
  • On-Board pays for employees' steel-toed boots
  • Growth opportunities / Onsite Training / Certifications
  • 11 paid holidays
  • Employee Referral Program: $250 / Per Referral (Conditional requirements – Must be employed for 90 days)

Today, On-Board is a thriving privately held family of companies with services including Consulting, Professional Engineering, Industrial Maintenance and Facility Management, Contracted Manufacturing and Production Services, as well as Temporary Staffing and Recruiting throughout North America. Location: Valley View, OH

Schedule: 1st, 2nd, & 3rd shifts!

$1,000 Sign-On Bonus!




Job Summary:

The Quality Inspector applies general knowledge of quality systems and requirements to assure compliance. Makes recommendations to management based on this information. Reviews data and monitors compliance with customer specifications.

Responsibilities:
  • Evaluates and reviews data using statistical methodology and monitors compliance with customer specifications
  • Makes recommendations to management personnel, based on this information

Starting rate:
 
  • First Shift $21.50, upon completion of training and obtaining a Certified Operator Stamp within 90 days the employee receives a $1.00 increase. The new hire will have the opportunity to request the Certified Quality Inspector book after obtaining their COP Stamp. The company pays for the book and test (one time). When the employee passes the test and obtains the certification which is good for life and valid anywhere in the US, they will receive an additional $1.00 per hour increase.
 
  • The Second and Third Shift will start at $22.00 which includes the .50 cent shift differential, upon completion of training within 90 days a $1.00 increase, upon obtaining a Certified Operator Stamp within 90 days the employee receives a $1.00 increase. The new hire will have the opportunity to request the Certified Quality Inspector book after obtaining their COP Stamp. The company pays for the book and test (one time). When the employee passes the test and obtains the certification which is good for life and valid anywhere in the US, they will receive an additional $1.00 per hour increase.
 
Requirements:
  • Inspector candidates need significant process experience and Quality knowledge and training to make appropriate business-based decisions.
  • Six years plus experience in the aerospace industry is needed (or equivalent).
  • Candidates need a strong inspection background, along with inspection skills and the ability to use gages, micrometers, height gages, optical comparators, and bench set ups on surface plates.
  • Strong knowledge of manual measurements gauges.
  • Micrometers, calipers, indicators, drop indicators, height stands, etc. Optical Comparator experience, ability to read CMM and Micro Vu reports.
  • Candidates must also have experience in Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerance (GD&T), blueprint reading, and knowledge of Quality audits associated with the aerospace industry.
  • CMM knowledge on aerospace parts is a plus, with close working tolerance of plus or minus .0002 on parts. Knowledge of SPC is very helpful.
  • HS Diploma or GED required
  • Professional experience in a manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to follow written work instructions is a must.
  • This position is located in an industrial environment and all employees are expected to follow safety rules, meet production expectations, and uphold quality standards.
Training Requirements:
  • At DVV/SW, Inspectors are required to acquire in-house training to meet the requirements of the Certified Operator Program (COP), a 5-level training program designed to satisfy corporate and customer standards and norms. Basic COP requirements are as follows: Must obtain within 90 days of employment.
LEVEL 1
  • Foreign Object Damage/Debris
  • DVV/SW – Intro to SPC
  • DVV/SW – Quality Paperwork Package
  • DVV/SW – Blueprint Reading
  • DVV/SW – Basic Gaging
  • DVV/SW – Most Valuable Resources
  • Make Traksys Movements
  • Basic Shop Math
 
LEVEL 2
  • Participate in Gage Studies
  • Oven Operations
  • Perform Basic Inspections
 
LEVEL 3
  • Skill- and work cell-specific requirements
  • Part Marking
  • Troubleshooting Molding Processes
  • Certified Visual (20hrs/5-lot sample audit)
 
LEVEL 4
  • Skill- and work cell-specific requirements
  • DVV/SW – GD&T
  • Know how to issue materials
 
LEVEL 5
  • Advanced Gaging/Layout
  • Intermediate Shop Math (Algebra)
 
ADVANCED LEVEL – RECEIVING INSPECTORS: Inspectors who have satisfied training requirements and who have demonstrated satisfactory work performance have the option of advancing to the Receiving Inspector role. Additional requirements for this position include:
  • Receiving Inspection, including Cert Review
  • Microsoft Excel (SPC)

description:
On-Board Services is hiring a Biological Research Technician in
Indianapolis, IN

For immediate consideration please send your resume to resumes@onboardusa.com
Subject Line: Position Title and State you are located
 
About Us:
On-Board Services, Incorporated is an on-site contract service provider for a local manufacturing entity providing full time positions to our employees. We offer benefits as well as 401k.
 
Position Details:

Title: Biological Research Technician
Position Type: 1 year contract with additional opportunity contingent upon performance and continued business need
Job Location: Indianapolis, IN   
Shift: 1st Shift
Benefits: 401K, Dental insurance, Life Insurance, Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance 
Compensation: $22/HR
 
Position Overview
The Laboratory Technician will work hands-on with insects, nematodes, and plant material in laboratory, greenhouse, and insectary settings. This position involves performing routine, detailed experimental work and supporting entomology research and testing. The role requires adherence to strict safety and ergonomic standards. Comprehensive training will be provided on all safety, laboratory, and ergonomic protocols.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Conduct laboratory and greenhouse work involving insects, nematodes, and plant material.
  • Clip and thin plants used for testing.
  • Infest plant or artificial diet materials with various non-stinging, non-hazardous insect species.
  • Prepare and apply assay formulations using manual pipettes, hand sprayers, and track sprayers.
  • Grade and record insect assay results.
  • Prepare media used in entomology testing.
  • Maintain laboratory cleanliness, restock supplies, and support overall lab organization.
  • Scribe and assist evaluators during testing.
 
Work Environment & Safety
  • Work will be performed across laboratory, greenhouse, and insectary environments.
  • Standing for extended periods is required.
  • Exposure to insects, latex, and chemicals (chemical sprays will be used).
  • PPE provided by employer for both laboratory and spraying work.
  • Medical clearance required to wear a PAPR, including Pulmonary Function testing and Cholinesterase evaluation (to be completed during onboarding).
  • Bee Survey to be completed later in employment.
  • Must adhere to all  EH&S protocols, safety standards, and PPE requirements.
Requirements
  • Education:
    • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Entomology, or Nematology preferred (recent graduates welcome).
  • Experience:
    • Prior work experience required (not necessarily in a lab environment).
    • Experience in entomology or with insects/nematodes is strongly preferred.
  • Skills and Attributes:
    • Self-motivated, reliable, and adaptable with the ability to shift focus as needed.
    • Works effectively both independently and as part of a team.
    • Strong communication, organization, and time management skills.
    • Able to follow detailed directions, protocols, and safety procedures.
    • Desire to learn and grow within a research environment.

  • Organized, ambitious with the ability to drive work effectively in an expedited time frame

  • Willing and able to wear required PPE (personal protective equipment)

Summary:
This position will be responsible for all aspects of project management of capital projects from conceptual scope development, detailed design, management of the design team, construction management, and leading the start-up, commissioning, and training activities. Specific duties will include items such as interacting with the plant personnel, gathering information, developing, and costing conceptual solutions, detailed design, safety design, developing project justifications and cost estimates, schedule development, and cost management.

The individual will also be responsible for development of construction packages, equipment and contractor procurement, coordination of construction activities, and for startup and commissioning activities. The individual must be self-motivated and be able to work as a team or independently on multiple concurrent projects.

Of Note
This position is part of our dedicated and nested site operations team, which means this role will continue in perpetuity if the selected candidate’s performance meets expectations. The ideal candidate will be someone who looking to establish roots and stay for many years to come as an integral part of the team.

Duties:
  • Lead multifunctional project teams consisting of plant and maintenance personnel, product line teams, and contractors.
  • Develop and manage mid-sized to large capital projects.
  • Complete conceptual project studies including Font End Loading development, preliminary scope development, cost estimates, and schedules.
  • Develop detailed project studies including comprehensive project scope documents, project justifications, definitive cost estimates, and project schedules.
  • Develop design documents including layout drawings, multifunctional discipline drawings, equipment drawings, and piping drawings.
  • Compile and submit project capital request documentation including justification, scope details, project schedules, cost estimates and compliance.
  • Execute and manage all aspects of approved capital projects including engineering design, procurement, and generation of purchase orders, contractor work package development, building permit applications, health and safety plans for construction, construction coordination, startup and commissioning, managing project costs and project schedules.

  • Control project plan by reviewing design, specifications, and plan and schedule changes; recommending actions.
  • Control project costs by approving expenditures; working with purchasing to administer contractor contracts.
  • Prepare project status reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and project specifics, recommending actions.
  • Maintain safe and clean working environment by enforcing procedures, rules, and regulations.
  • Maintain product and company reputation by complying with federal and state regulations.
  • Assist plant teams in identifying appropriate projects for annual budgeting.

  • BS in Engineering with minimum 3+ years capex project management/engineering experience required.
  • Experience in mechanical, electrical, civil, structural and controls design and construction projects is required.
  • Must have excellent written and oral communications skills.
  • Must be familiar with industry standard project management techniques.
  • Must have experience developing contractor work packages, managing contracts and coordinating contractors.
  • Must have experience in leading a multi-functional project team.
  • Must have experience in developing and managing project schedules and project costs.
  • Proficient use of MS Office Suite.
  • Proficiency with SAP MM and PS modules is a plus, but not a requirement.
  • Must have a working knowledge of applicable OSHA standards, Regulatory Compliance and Building Code Requirements.
  • Must have a solid working knowledge of process operations.
Other Requirements:
  • Must have U.S.A. citizenship
  • Drug and background screening required
  • Must be clean shaven
  • Must be willing to travel to other clients site ~30% of the time

  • Work may require using and wearing personal protective equipment such as fire-retardant clothing, hearing and eye protection, hard hat and steel-toed boots
  • Day-to-day physical requirements involve standard office activities including sitting/standing for extended periods of time, attending meetings, use of keyboard and mouse repetitively, lifting and carrying less than 20 lbs frequently, etc
  • Work requires moderate physical exertion including walking to operating areas and walking up stairs. Employee will need to climb up the stairs up to the 2 nd and as high as the 10 th floor of the operating buildings up to 1 to 3 times per week. Conducting walk downs and walking to the operating areas will require walking 200 to 1200 yards on some days of the week. Structural Engineer

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Structural Engineer to join the capital projects engineering team. This role involves providing structural engineering support for all phases of capital projects at chemical plants: initial planning and scoping, detailed engineering and design, and construction.

Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Structural engineering and design for steel structures, equipment supports (pumps, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, etc.), pipe supports, pipe racks, concrete foundations for tanks / equipment, equipment pads, analysis of existing structures and foundations, underground piping, etc.

description:
On-Board Engineering is hiring a full-time Industrial Construction Manager in Bryan, TX!
For immediate consideration please send your resume to resumes@onboardusa.com
Subject Line: Position and State Located

Position Details:
Position Type: Full-Time, 12 month contract with a target start date in Q1 2026
Job Location: Bryan, TX
Benefits: Paid time off, paid holidays and health benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K (roth and traditional)
Compensation: $65.00 - $90.00/hr depending upon qualifications
Drug and background screenings required

Overview:
Our client site manufactures and supplies ultra high purity hydrofluoric acid (UHPHF) for the semiconductor industry.

Primary Responsibilities:
  • Oversee construction of a 12-month project at the Bryan Texas facility. This project includes the installation of new Experion DCS Hardware and universal marshalling, the installation of a historian, the installation of a redundant fiber optic network, the installation of all new networking hardware, and the migration of approximately 1,200 I/O points.
  • Scope of services are to include:
    • Travel as needed to the Bryan, TX facility.
    • Oversite and facilitation of all onsite activities.
    • Understanding of all LOTO, permitting, and construction safety procedures.
    • Coordination between external contractors and client operations regarding all LOTO / permitting activities.
    • Addressing any design related issues in the field, escalating as needed based on best judgement.
    • Daily schedule updates of onsite activities including equipment deliveries, construction progress, and CSU efforts.
    • Conducting daily safety audits.
    • Enforcement of all HSE procedures.
    • Addressing safety issues including near misses, conducting field investigations as necessary and escalation of all incidents.
    • Liaison for On-Board Engineering home office and client site with representation on weekly conference calls.
Schedule:
  • The CM should expect to work a 5 x 10 schedule Monday through Friday, with up to 4 weeks of 7 x 10 during I/O cutovers requiring unit outages.

Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of relevant project engineering and construction management experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required
  • Industrial plant experience in chemical processing (or related) required.
  • MIOSHA /OSHA certified preferred with in field experience
  • Fluent at reading and interpreting P&ID’s and Isometric drawings
  • Developed and Implemented safe work strategies and ensure site and contractor safety
  • Working knowledge of SAP, MS Office, or similar databases
  • Good communication and presentation skills (both oral and written).
  • Good interpersonal and Conflict Resolution Skills with the ability to influence managers, peers, and maintenance team.
  • Ability to utilize other software tools as appropriate SAP, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Project, Visio, Outlook, SharePoint)

Other Requirements:
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

Physical Requirements:
Work is located at a chemical plant and requires exposure to ambient temperature extremes
Work may require using and wearing personal protective equipment such as fire-retardant clothing, hearing and eye protection, hard hat and steel-toed boots
Day-to-day physical requirements involve standard office activities including sitting/standing for extended periods of time, attending meetings, use of keyboard and mouse repetitively, lifting and carrying less than 20 lbs frequently, etc
Work requires moderate physical exertion including walking to operating areas and walking up stairs. Employee will need to climb up the stairs up to the 2 nd and as high as the 10 th floor of the operating buildings up to 1 to 3 times per week.
Conducting walk downs and walking to the operating areas will require walking 200 to 1200 yards on some days of the week. Employee will need to bend over and reach over their heads to verify instruments, wiring, connections and control systems in the field.
Assignments may require conducting plant walkdowns and wearing chemical plant or refinery PPE to include eye protection, hearing protection, hard hat, steel toed shoes, chemical resistant gloves and FP coveralls.

description:
On-Board Engineering is hiring a CAD Designer in Baton Rouge, LA!
​

Position Details:
Position Type: Full Time
Job Location: Baton Rouge, LA (Office-based, with hybrid flexibility once acclimated to the position, and local travel to client sites may be required)
Benefits: Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision), Paid Vacation, Paid Holidays, 401k
Compensation: $35 - $60/hr, depending on experience and qualifications
Background and Drug Screenings Required

Overview:
We are seeking a skilled Multi-Disciplined CAD Designer with Civil, Structural, and Architectural (CSA) design, piping systems and electrical design experience to join our team. The successful candidate will play a critical role in developing detailed designs and drawings for industrial projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards and client specifications. This position requires expertise in AutoCAD software, an understanding of chemical process facilities, and the ability to collaborate across disciplines to support project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and Drafting: Create detailed 2D and 3D CAD drawings for CSA and piping systems, including piping layouts, isometric drawings, structural plans, and foundation designs for chemical process facilities.
  • Project Collaboration: Work closely with engineers, project managers, and other designers to ensure designs meet project requirements and integrate seamlessly with other systems.
  • Piping Design: Develop piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), equipment layouts, and piping specifications in compliance with industry codes (e.g., ASME B31.3).
  • CSA Design: Produce civil and structural designs, including site layouts, concrete foundations, steel structures, and architectural components for industrial facilities.
  • Experience in electrical design, including the creation of electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and power distribution layouts for industrial facilities, is desirable.
  • Standards Compliance: Ensure all designs adhere to relevant industry standards, client specifications, and safety regulations, including OSHA and local building codes.
  • Model Reviews: Participate in 3D model reviews to identify potential clashes, interferences, or constructability issues, and propose solutions to optimize designs.
  • Documentation: Prepare and maintain accurate design documentation, including bill of materials (BOM), equipment lists, and as-built drawings.
  • Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on advancements in CAD technology, industry standards, and best practices to enhance design efficiency and quality.
  • Client Interaction: Occasionally interface with clients to clarify requirements, present designs, and incorporate feedback to meet project objectives.
Qualifications
  • Education: Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum of 1 year of experience as a CAD Designer
  • Technical Skills:
    • Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, AutoCAD Plant 3D, Revit, or MicroStation).
    • Experience with 3D modeling tools for piping and structural design (e.g., PDMS, SmartPlant, or Navisworks).
    • Familiarity with P&ID software and piping specification development.
    • Knowledge of industry standards (e.g., ASME, ACI, AISC, IBC).
  • Soft Skills:
    • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
    • Excellent communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
    • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet project deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
